notes.text: SCOPE: tessile/abbigliamento/moda sub-sector only. Calzature, pelli, occhiali, giocattoli have separate salary tables not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Model the calzature, pelli, occhiali and giocattoli salary tables with a sub-sector input.

notes.text: VV.PP. (Venditori Viaggiatori e Piazzisti) levels excluded; only Jan-2026 data available from primary sources, historical tranches not found.
APPRENTICESHIP: not modelled (set to []). Primary source for post-2024 apprenticeship rules not identified.
SALARY MODEL: conglobated (single minimo mensile, no separate contingenza or EDR). Source: lavoro-economia.it explicitly divides monthly by 173 to derive hourly rate, no separate component columns.
LEVEL 1: jumps to 1558.00 EUR/month at Jan 2025 (9.006 EUR/h, exceeds 9 EUR/h floor per CCNL art. 33bis). Frozen in Jan 2026 and Jan 2027 — excluded from standard tranche mechanism.
LEVEL 8 IDF: indennità di funzione 51.65 EUR modelled as fixed_allowance (unverified for period before Jan 2026). Function-conditional, not automatic for all L8 workers.
FONDAPI: the contributions are computed on the contractual minimum of the level; the Fondapi base also counts the EDR, not in the bundle pay.

The Fondapi base ('retribuzione Fondapi' or 'elemento retributivo nazionale') counts the EDR besides the minimum; the bundle pay of this CCNL does not hold them, so the fund contributions of an enrolled worker are computed on the minimum alone and understated.

limitation.remediation: Model the EDR in the pay of the CCNL and add them to the Fondapi base, then remove this note.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: CCNL PMI TESSILE, ABBIGLIAMENTO, MODA, CALZATURE, PELLI E CUOIO, PENNE, SPAZZOLE E PENNELLI, OCCHIALI, GIOCATTOLI
location.quote: Minima stabilita dal CCNL: 1,60% calcolata su 'elemento retributivo nazionale' [...] Dal 1° gennaio 2026 le aliquote contributive a carico dell'Azienda vengono incrementate dello 0,10% (CCNL UNIONTESSILE accordo di rinnovo del 18/02/2025). Aliquota stabilita dal CCNL (cfr. tabella) calcolata su 'elemento retributivo nazionale'; Contributo lavoratore 1,60% o superiore, Contributo azienda dal 01/01/2026 2,00%; legenda: 'elemento retributivo nazionale' = minimo tabellare + elemento distinto della retribuzione

provenance.transformation: Employer 2.00% and worker minimum 1.60% of the contractual minimum of the level, the consolidated minimum of the bundle.
provenance.note: Read from the PDF the url serves (sha256 7e9b29394505b6cd14125c88c6f0cc4ba78c14f026b546bb387636e40e42ee15), text layer. The Fondapi base also counts the EDR, which the bundle pay does not hold: an open limitation of the CCNL keeps an enrolled run from being paid.
